name: Inscriptions
overview: The Scriptures record inscriptions prominently displayed above Jesus during His crucifixion, identifying Him as 'The King of the Jews' in multiple languages, as seen in Matthew 27:37, Mark 15:26, Luke 23:38, and John 19:19. These inscriptions, written by Pilate and others, serve both as a formal accusation and a declaration of Jesus’ true identity, highlighting the fulfillment of His messianic role. The use of inscriptions on gravestones and at the cross underscores the significance of written words in marking identity and testimony in biblical times.
